strengths: Cover letter has an authentic, specific opening hook about biopharma RAG work that immediately establishes credibility
Gap handling is excellent - honestly acknowledges lack of classical ML/NLP depth while positioning applied LLM experience as complementary
Document intelligence focus is genuinely relevant to EvenUp's legal document work - this is a strong narrative thread
Resume is clean, scannable, and well-structured with consistent formatting
Specific company research evident: valuation, investors, and personal injury law focus mentioned naturally
weaknesses: Resume bullets lack impact metrics - 'tens of thousands of documents' and '300+ users' describe scale but not outcomes (accuracy improvements? time saved? efficiency gains?)

ATS keyword coverage is thin on core ML terms - missing: 'machine learning', 'NLP', 'neural networks', 'model training', 'TensorFlow', 'scikit-learn'. The role is 'Machine Learning Engineer' but resume reads like 'LLM Engineer'
Cover letter company research is surface-level - mentions valuation and investors but not EvenUp's actual products (Demand, Discovery, Medical Chronologies) or specific technical challenges they face
Differentiation is moderate - the document intelligence angle is good but not memorable enough to stand out in 200+ applications
revision_suggestions: Add impact metrics to resume bullets: 'Reduced document retrieval time by X%' or 'Improved reranker accuracy by Y%' or 'Enabled Z faster regulatory submissions' - outcome metrics, not just scale metrics
Weave in more ML terminology naturally: 'ML systems', 'NLP pipelines', 'model evaluation', 'feature engineering' where accurate - this helps ATS matching for 'Machine Learning Engineer' title
Deepen EvenUp company research: Reference specific products (Demand letter generation, Medical Chronologies) or technical blog posts/papers to show genuine interest, not just surface-level research
Consider adding a 'Selected Projects' section to resume highlighting one deep technical case study with before/after metrics

human_review_checklist.item: No section headings in cover letter
human_review_checklist.note: Cover letter is flowing prose with no ## headers or section breaks
